Huss Valley controls & device help

Use the visible game hints as your final reference. A keyboard list from an older guide can go out of date.

Reported controls

InputReported actionEvidence
SpaceDashMMORocks, October 3 game session
AltShow or hide cursorSame dated guide
Menu buttonOpen game menusGuide report; code route separately described by IGN

We have not verified Q, C, J or controller bindings for the current build. Check the game hints instead of importing controls from a similarly named experience.

Check an input in three steps

  1. Close the code field or chat so keyboard input reaches the game.
  2. Look for the current action hint and check whether your role can use it.
  3. Try the action once in open space and observe the result. Record your device and game message if it fails.

On a phone or tablet

Identify the movement, camera and action areas before a chase. Use the buttons the game actually displays; we have not confirmed the current touch layout. For pasting a code, follow the mobile redemption steps.

When movement feels inconsistent

Compare one deliberate input with repeated tapping. Check whether a text field is focused or a menu is open. If Roblox is disconnected, rejoin once. Report the action, role, device and visible result rather than assuming an undocumented cooldown.

Gameplay reference: MMORocks beginner guide, reviewed October 18, 2026; the author dates its game session October 3. We have not independently tested its gameplay reports. Official identity and capacity: Roblox. Interface details can change after updates.
